text: create_blueprint flag to disable new-account registration (API 403 + web notice)

Done in de156ee. create_blueprint(allow_registration=False): POST /register ->
403 registration_disabled (per-instance via get_config, so multi-mount can mix
open and closed instances); the serve-time __APP_CONFIG__ injection from T-60
carries allowRegistration, and the web login page renders the register toggle
disabled + "Registration is disabled on this server." notice. Android shows the
API message through its existing error path (no app change). Default unchanged.
